mentions.name: ZooKeeper
mentions.description: A Pokédex-style app for zoo trips that lets visitors photograph the animals they see to collect them; when a new animal is 'captured', it shows fun facts about it. It matches the photo against the zoo's list of animals to identify the species, and is seeded with UK zoos.
mentions.problem: Zoo signage was terrible, leaving visitors with no idea what some of the animals were.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a Pokédex for zoo trips for my girlfriend:

https://www.zookeeperapp.com

https://www.mikeayles.com/#zookeeper-wip

It lets you take photos of all the animals you see to collect them, when you 'capture' a new animal, it gives you fun facts about them.
